fields.label: PPN Applicable
fields.description: Tick only where PPN is actually charged or claimed.

fields.label: Input VAT Creditable
fields.description: Untick for input VAT that cannot be credited (Pajak Masukan tidak dapat dikreditkan).

fields.label: Statutory Rate
fields.description: The rate in the law. 12 since 1 January 2025.

fields.label: DPP Numerator
fields.description: Numerator of the DPP Nilai Lain fraction. 11 for the standard 11/12 base.

fields.label: DPP Denominator
fields.description: Denominator of the DPP Nilai Lain fraction. Set both to 12 for the full-rate base used by luxury goods.

fields.options: Effective rate = statutory rate x numerator / denominator. 12% on an 11/12 base is 11% of the selling price.

fields.description: Where deliveries under this treatment are reported in Part I.

fields.label: Input VAT Line
fields.description: Where purchases under this treatment are reported in Part II.

fields.label: Faktur Transaction Code
fields.description: e-Faktur kode transaksi, e.g. 01 standard, 02 government collector, 07 not collected, 08 exempt.

fields.label: Regional Tax Rate (PBJT)
fields.description: For services taxed by the regency instead of PPN. Capped at 10% under UU HKPD.
